prompts.prompt:
[SCENE]
Evening after-work hour at a private study cafe booth, approximately 9 PM. A compact individual desk carved into a quiet corner, warm interior ambient light mixing with the soft glow of city nightscape visible through a large window behind the subject. Late weeknight atmosphere — still, focused, slightly exhausted but self-determined.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
No commercial product. A ceramic matte coffee cup sits at the upper-right of the desk surface, steam barely visible, alongside a closed notebook and uncapped pen resting diagonally. These are incidental scene objects, not focal products.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
A Korean woman in her mid-to-late twenties, either: hands only visible — fingers resting lightly on a laptop keyboard, natural unmanicured nails, slight fatigue in the hand posture — or a three-quarter rear view showing the back of her head, loose hair slightly disheveled from a long workday, shoulders relaxed forward in quiet concentration. No face shown in either composition.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Narrow wooden desk surface in warm walnut grain, a slim laptop open with a faint screen glow casting cool 6500K light onto the desk. A ceramic matte cup with a small handle to the upper right. A softcover notebook with a pen resting across it. The window behind reveals an out-of-focus urban night skyline — blurred building lights and streetlamp halos in deep amber and cool blue. Acoustic panel or frosted partition visible at the desk edge suggesting the private booth enclosure.

[LIGHTING]
Primary: motivated practical light from a small warm-toned desk lamp at 3200K tungsten, positioned 45° camera-right, casting a gentle directional pool across the desk surface with soft falloff with gradient transition into shadow. Secondary: ambient skylight from the city window behind at 7000K blue hour, creating a subtle three-quarter back rim separation on the subject's shoulders and hair. Screen glow provides a cold 6500K under-fill on the hands. Shadow behavior: deep shadow side on the left with selective fill, contact shadow only at base of cup and notebook.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 50mm standard, aperture f/2.0, shallow depth of field with focus locked on the hands at keyboard or the upper back and nape of neck depending on composition. City window background rendered as smooth bokeh wash of amber and blue light orbs.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Intimate and quietly introspective. The air feels slightly still — the kind of focused solitude that belongs to someone reclaiming time after a long day. Subtle warmth against the cool city dark outside. A sense of self-possession, not loneliness.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Deep walnut brown and muted charcoal as dominant tones. Warm amber from the desk lamp pooling on the wood surface. Cool desaturated blue-violet from the city window bokeh. Low contrast overall with a slight cinematic underexposure.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Beth Kirby, Brittany Ambridge, and Pia Ulin. Editorial lifestyle photography with a quiet domestic-meets-urban sensibility.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic skin and hand texture — visible knuckle detail, natural hand fatigue posture, no retouching on skin. Authentic material textures on wood grain and ceramic. Film-adjacent tonal rendering with no digital sharpness artifacts.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no asymmetric eyes,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no visible text, no letters, no numbers, no signage, no screen-readable characters anywhere in the frame.

resolution: 2k
